text:
May 19, 2018 admin Trading Ideas Comments Off on Apple fans are raging that the new MacBook Pro has an unreliable keyboard — so I wrote this article with one to show you how bad it can be (AAPL)
On Wednesday, the “G” key on my 15-inch 2016 MacBook Pro — a model sporting the newest butterfly keyboard design — started acting up for the second time since I bought it. For the rest of this short post, I will not correct any typographical errors related to the letter “G,” and I’ll embolden the affected words to show what happens when Apple’s butterfly keyboard becomes defective, startin now. …read more
